subject: general
question: Who among the following is the head of Nuclear Command Authority, NITI Aayog, Appointments Committee of the Cabinet, Department of Atomic Energy, Department of Space and Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Prime Minister** of India is the head of several important bodies including the **Nuclear Command Authority**, **NITI Aayog**, **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet**, **Department of Atomic Energy**, **Department of Space**, and **Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions**.
 
• The **Nuclear Command Authority** is responsible for the command, control, and operational decisions regarding India's nuclear weapons program.
 
• The **NITI Aayog** serves as the policy think tank of the Government of India and provides both directional and policy inputs.
 
• The **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet** is responsible for appointments to several top posts under the Government of India.
 
• The **Department of Atomic Energy** and **Department of Space** are crucial for India's advancements in nuclear and space technologies, respectively.
 
• The **Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions** deals with personnel matters, especially those related to recruitment, training, career development, staff welfare, and post-retirement dispensation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Prime Minister** is appointed by the President of India and is usually the leader of the party that has a majority in the Lok Sabha.
 
• The Prime Minister plays a critical role in the governance and administration of the country, acting as the chief advisor to the President of India and the head of the Council of Ministers.
 
• As the head of the government, the Prime Minister is responsible for implementing laws and policies passed by the Parliament and for the overall administration of the executive branch.
